name: Ambush
objective: Lie in wait and destroy the convoy before it escapes.
brief: A {enemy_name} supply group passes this way. Go to passive sensors, let it come to you, and destroy it before it gets clear: it will run, not fight.

objectives.text: Destroy or take every ship before it escapes
